# Competitor analysis

> Big agencies are slow, freelancers are cheap but alone. We sell speed and a partner who stays.

## Competitor A: a large agency
- Long offers, three-month projects.

## Competitor B: a freelancer network
- Low prices, no maintenance.

## Conclusion
- Keep packages small and launch within six weeks.
